No sanitizer (e.g. Sanitize/Loofah) is invoked anywhere in the import path shown, so feed/remote content is rendered as-is — a real XSS/security defect introduced by this change.

adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly introduces a `:raw_html` cook method where `Post#cook` returns `raw` verbatim (`app/models/post.rb`), and `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts from remote `contents` using `PostCreator.new(... raw: absolutize_urls(url, contents), skip_validations: true, cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html])` (`app/models/topic_embed.rb`). No HTML sanitization is shown in this import path: `absolutize_urls` only rewrites relative `href`/`src`, `PollFeed` only does `CGI.unescapeHTML(... .scrub)` (encoding cleanup), and `import_remote` uses Readability but still passes `doc.content` through the same raw_html path. The embed view renders with `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (`app/views/embed/best.html.erb`), making stored remote HTML execute as-is. This is a verifiable persistent XSS risk introduced/exposed by the diff.
